title: Connect WhatsApp
blurb: Link your WhatsApp Business account so chats land in Conversations.

steps.title: Open Settings
steps.body: Click **Settings** at the bottom of the left menu.

steps.title: Before you start
steps.body: You need admin access to your business's Facebook (Meta) Business account, and a phone number that can receive a code by text or call.

steps.title: Start setup
steps.body: Click the button to get started. If asked to subscribe, that monthly fee goes on your Luubu bill.
steps.tip: Not sure about the cost? Email hello@luubu.com before you subscribe.

steps.title: Log in to Meta
steps.body: A Meta window opens. Log in, pick or create your business, and enter your WhatsApp display name (usually your business name).

steps.title: Verify the number
steps.body: Enter your number and the code Meta sends you.

steps.title: Check the status
steps.body: Back in Luubu, the top card shows your account status. WhatsApp messages now arrive in **Conversations**.
